_doc: Cron resource manifest for session-coord. Copy to the path your deployment
Each key is a cron job id from your scheduler's job store. Fields:
resources : list of coordination resource keys the job touches
name      : human-readable job name (shown in advisories and notes)
policy    : 'wait' (bounded wait for holders, then proceed — backups) or
'skip' (skip the tick instantly — watchdogs and pollers)
critical  : true = sessions must never let this job defer silently;
claim-time advisories switch to an explicit decision brief
This file is OPTIONAL. Missing or malformed -> all cron features are inert
and jobs run exactly as they always did (fail-open).
